prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 员工花名册 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "工号" · longest unbreakable word 53px · one-line width 53px
  col 2: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 62px
  col 3: header "部门" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "职级" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "入职日期" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 85px
  col 6: header "主要职责" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 491px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示员工的身份、组织归属、职级、入职时间和主要职责，供查阅与比较。","reading":"读者可先按工号或姓名定位员工，再横向查看同一行的部门、职级、日期和职责；也可纵向比较部门、职级或入职日期。","groups":["工号和姓名共同标识员工，适合保持紧凑且完整。","部门和职级共同描述组织归属与层级，便于纵向比较。","入职日期是独立的时间字段，主要职责是篇幅较长的说明字段。"],"keep_intact":["工号、姓名、职级和完整入职日期应尽量保持在一行。","部门名称尽量完整，以便快速扫描；空间紧张时可自然换行。"],"may_wrap":["主要职责可按中文自然换行；较长职责形成的行高也可容纳同一行其他字段的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [74, 83, 98, 52, 106, 306] · table 720×288px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 60, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [74, 83, 70, 51, 106, 335] · table 720×358px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [80, 90, 105, 56, 110, 278] · table 720×288px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 60, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"工号、姓名、部门、职级和日期均保持单行，表头完整；职责自然分成最多两行，同一行的信息容易对应。各列紧凑，职责列获得了最多空间。","problems":"部分列宽接近内容的最低需求，视觉上较紧；长职责的两行与短职责的单行交替，行高有所变化，但没有妨碍逐行阅读。","cause":"前五列分别为74、83、98、52、106px，基本按最长单行内容分配；306px的职责列使较长说明换成两行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"335px的职责列较宽，长职责的换行位置比其他方案稍宽松；工号、姓名和日期仍易于扫描。","problems":"职级表头断成两行，部门名称也分成两行，表头和每条记录都因此变高；部门名称的纵向比较变得费力，而职责列增加的宽度并未减少长职责的行数。","cause":"51px的职级列不足以让表头完整显示；70px的部门列只有49px文本宽度，容不下最长的部门名称。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"表头和身份、部门、职级、日期均完整显示；较宽的前几列带来舒展的留白，行的对应关系清楚。","problems":"前几列的额外留白压缩了职责列，使长说明更早换行，而表格高度和长职责行数与r0A相同。","cause":"工号、姓名、部门、职级和日期列分别比r0A宽4、7、7、4、4px，职责列因此缩至278px。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
